about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Second Sunday after Epiphany” in the 1962 Roman Missal. Page 45 prints the proper body with a short Per Dóminum cue. The full conclusion is expanded under Rubricae generales 115 a from printed fragments on pages 123 and 226 of the same edition. It is not a continuous transcription of one page.

s01.translation: May the working of Your power increase within us, we beseech You, O Lord, that, strengthened by the divine sacraments, we may by Your gift be prepared to receive the things they promise. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.
